# AMZN — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (April 29 after close) were a blowout — EPS $2.78 vs $1.64 consensus, revenue $181.5B, AWS +28% YoY. The catalyst fired and was immediately sold: price gapped to $273.88 on April 30, then closed at $265.06 on 2.05x volume. The earnings event is fully priced. No new binary catalyst within 10 trading days. Q2 2026 earnings estimated July 30, 2026. Amazon Ads Upfront (May 11, NYC) is the nearest dated event — ad-showcase, not a binary. New non-earnings catalysts: Globalstar $11.57B acquisition and Amazon Supply Chain Services launch are structural positives absorbed into current price. Macro headwind: Iran missile strike on US warship (May 4), WTI above $105. [source: web_research/AMZN.json, run 20260504_173321]

---

## Upcoming events (as of May 4, 2026)

| Event | Date | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| Amazon Ads Upfront 2026 | May 11, 2026 | Low-medium — ad-tech showcase; positive tone expected but not a binary |
| Fed leadership transition | May 15, 2026 | Medium — Powell last day; Warsh (hawkish) as likely successor adds policy uncertainty |
| Q2 2026 Earnings | July 30, 2026 (after close) | High — next binary; Q2 revenue guide $194-199B |
| US midterm elections | November 2026 | Low-medium — tech/cloud regulation policy uncertainty |
| Iran-U.S. escalation (live) | Ongoing | High — WTI >$105; Strait of Hormuz closure is tail risk for AWS data center energy costs and global shipping |

---

## Q1 2026 earnings synthesis (fired — fully priced)

**Beat magnitude:** EPS $2.78 vs $1.64 estimate (+$1.14 beat, 69.5% upside surprise). Revenue $181.5B (+17% YoY). AWS $37.6B (+28% YoY). Q2 2026 revenue guide $194-199B; operating income $20-24B. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

**Market reaction:** "Sell the news" — price gapped to $273.88 on April 30, closed at $265.06. Bearish shooting star on 2.05x average volume. Entire +27% pre-earnings price run was the implied consensus.

**AI infrastructure anchors:** OpenAI confirmed using Amazon Trainium chips; Anthropic multi-year AWS commitment. These are structural positives absorbed into the current price. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

---

## New non-earnings catalysts (since run 20260501)

**Globalstar acquisition ($11.57B):** Second-largest deal in Amazon history — adds satellite connectivity optionality for logistics and rural delivery. Sentiment: positive long-term, no near-term price catalyst.

**Amazon Supply Chain Services:** Launched for external businesses, expanding logistics revenue beyond first-party retail. Potential margin diversification. Sentiment: positive, not a near-term binary. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

**$200B AI capex plan:** Investor scrutiny over the $200B AI capital expenditure plan is a live bearish overhang — cash flow concerns noted by analysts. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

## What would reactivate the long catalyst stack

- **Price pulls back to $258-261:** Trend-momentum agent would re-engage with a 2:1+ R:R long entry.
- **AWS Q2 guidance beat:** Material upside to the $194-199B Q2 guide would re-rate the stock.
- **Iran de-escalation:** Durable ceasefire removes energy-cost tail risk and restores risk-on bid.
